description: Share a design with somebody else, or take that sharing back. `actorId` is the other party's actor id as this server spells it — `github:<login>` for a signed-in person, `operator` for the token holder, `agent:<fingerprint>` for another agent's grant; ui_builder_design_access lists the ones a design already carries. A `viewer` may read and export, an `editor` may also change the design, and neither may share it on. Only the design's owner may share it, and an agent acting under an approved grant shares as the person who approved that grant. Pass visibility instead of actorId to choose private or public (read only). Private keeps existing invited collaborators.

actorId.description: Who to share with, e.g. github:octocat.

agentModel.description: Optional current model name shown to design viewers; self-reported. Omit when unknown.

agentName.description: Optional agent/client name shown to design viewers; self-reported.

revoke.description: Take this actor's access away instead.

role.description: editor or viewer. Defaults to viewer.

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

visibility.description: Change visibility instead of an actor grant. Public is read only. Private keeps invited collaborators.

name: ui_builder_share_design
